title: Staging Cloudflare managed authority readiness substrate

phases.objective: Add the Staging-only managed Cloudflare credential/config readiness substrate and expose complete dry-run blockers without widening provider apply authorization.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Build the profile-bound activation_gateway_dark_deploy dry-run for admin_cloudflare_v1.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The adapter resolves managed credential metadata and the durable Staging feature gate from Runtime DB, reports independent dispatch certification state, and remains apply_ready=false while certification or Governance authorization is not ready.
steps: Replay Runtime-owned managed Cloudflare connected-system, DB-encrypted secret-slot/reference/binding, and durable feature-gate metadata.
Resolve provider credential readiness through credential_bindings while keeping the secret value out of dry-run output.
Resolve the Staging apply gate from platform_runtime_config.
Read independent runtime_dispatch_certification_registry state from Governance DB.
Keep apply fail-closed until all existing capability-envelope, certification, typed-confirmation, audit, readback and rollback gates are satisfied.
assertions: No raw Cloudflare credential is committed or returned.
Legacy file/env provider settings are diagnostic compatibility only and are not sufficient for apply readiness.
Governance policy requires the managed credential binding and managed Runtime config, and forbids a no-credential apply path.
The Staging apply adapter is classified staging-only and excluded from shared Production runtime impact.
The exact profile resource binding remains server-selected; caller target override stays forbidden.
Recovery replay restores metadata only and does not perform a provider call.
Production, DNS, custom-domain, Hostinger and automatic provider mutation remain false.
